child_turn.text:
Oh yeah! 🌞

The sky is blue because of tiny little “color dancers” called *molecules* in the air. Sunlight is like a big rainbow, but when it hits those molecules, they dance and bounce — and blue light? It’s the favorite color of the dancers! 🌈

So the sky gets a blue sparkle because blue light loves to bounce around and show off. 🌌

And guess what? When the sun’s lower, like at sunset, the sky turns orange or red — because the blue light gets tired and hides, and the orange light gets to shine! 🌅

So... sky’s blue = blue light is having fun dancing! 😊
